title: OBC v2 Off-Chain Journal Document
description: Schema for the off-chain JSON document stored in file storage. Version 2 adds support for multi-dimensional accounting with up to 10 account codes per line item.

version.description: Off-chain document version. Always 2 for this standard.

documentJournalId.description: Unique journal ID from the source system.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, AUD).

journalType.description: Type of journal (manual, invoice, purchase, etc.).

includeInVatReturn.description: Whether to include in VAT return.

isBasAdjustment.description: Whether this is a BAS adjustment entry.

pricePrecision.description: Number of decimal places for amounts.

originalCreatedTime.description: When the document was created in the source system (ISO 8601).

lastModifiedTime.description: When the document was last modified in the source system (ISO 8601).

originalStatus.description: Status of the document in the source system.

customFields.description: Tenant-defined custom metadata. May be empty.

accountCode1.description: Multi-dimensional account code 1 (e.g., Department, Fund). May be anonymized.

accountCodeName1.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 1. May be anonymized.

accountCode2.description: Multi-dimensional account code 2 (e.g., Cost Center, Program). May be anonymized.

accountCodeName2.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 2. May be anonymized.

accountCode3.description: Multi-dimensional account code 3 (e.g., Project, Grant). May be anonymized.

accountCodeName3.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 3. May be anonymized.

accountCode4.description: Multi-dimensional account code 4 (e.g., Location). May be anonymized.

accountCodeName4.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 4. May be anonymized.

accountCode5.description: Multi-dimensional account code 5. May be anonymized.

accountCodeName5.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 5. May be anonymized.

accountCode6.description: Multi-dimensional account code 6. May be anonymized.

accountCodeName6.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 6. May be anonymized.

accountCode7.description: Multi-dimensional account code 7. May be anonymized.

accountCodeName7.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 7. May be anonymized.

accountCode8.description: Multi-dimensional account code 8. May be anonymized.

accountCodeName8.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 8. May be anonymized.

accountCode9.description: Multi-dimensional account code 9. May be anonymized.

accountCodeName9.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 9. May be anonymized.

accountCode10.description: Multi-dimensional account code 10. May be anonymized.

accountCodeName10.description: Multi-dimensional account code name 10. May be anonymized.

customerName.description: Associated customer name. May be anonymized.

taxName.description: Tax component name on the line. May be anonymized.

taxAuthorityName.description: Tax authority name. May be anonymized.

acquisitionVatName.description: Acquisition VAT name. May be anonymized.

reverseChargeVatName.description: Reverse charge VAT name. May be anonymized.
